description: Find independent UK restaurants that use TableSpark, by name, dish or cuisine words, town or postcode. Use this first to get a restaurant_id. Can filter to places open now, or that take table bookings or online orders.

offers.description: Only restaurants that take table bookings or online orders.

open_now.description: Only restaurants open right now (UK time).

query.description: Free text: restaurant name, cuisine or dish words, e.g. "thai" or "fish and chips".

town.description: UK town/city or postcode (full or outward code like "YO62").

name: search_restaurants
title: Search restaurants
